answer_1.quote: We introduce the task of summarizing conversation dynamics ... we release a dataset of SCDs ...
answer_1.outputs: Summaries of conversation dynamics (SCDs) that capture tone, strategies, and interaction trajectory

answer_4.quote: We recruit 20 university students fluent in English as participants ... they are asked to guess whether the conversation will derail, rate their confidence, and assess how well the summary helped them understand the topic and the conversation trajectory.
answer_4.guideline: Participants read a summary and answer: (1) will the conversation derail?, (2) confidence (1‑5), (3) how well the summary helped understand the topic (1‑5), (4) how well it helped understand the conversation trajectory (1‑5).
